verified_facts: Time Stamped DTM tiles are an archive of Environment Agency raster elevation surveys.
Time Stamped DTM survey resolutions include 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m depending on survey.
Time Stamped DTM removes surface objects to model terrain surface.
Time Stamped DTM is available as GeoTIFF rasters in 5km zip files.
Time Stamped DTM elevations are presented in metres.
Time Stamped DTM heights are referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn.
Time Stamped DTM data is aligned to the OS Grid.
EA states vertical accuracy of its LIDAR data is plus/minus 15cm RMSE.
The transformation used for time-stamped data is specific to the survey period.
Composite DTM 2m covers about 99 percent of England.
Where repeat surveys exist the composite selects newest, best-resolution data.
Where composite data is resampled EA states bilinear interpolation is used.
EA provides coverage metadata/index services to identify source survey lineage.
EA publishes persistent non-year-suffixed WCS URLs intended to keep serving current data.
DSM includes objects such as buildings and vegetation and therefore is not interchangeable with bare-earth DTM.
quality_effect: Pins elevation evidence to survey epoch, DTM surface semantics, OS Newlyn vertical reference and persistent WCS lineage while rejecting DSM-as-ground substitutions.
